g.text: Verification & Account Flow - Email/Phone Verify + Cross-Channel Contact Change (M3)
All endpoints below require a valid JWT (ApiInterceptor adds
the Bearer token). Cooldown (60s) and daily cap (5) violations
both answer 429 with one generic backend message, so the client
copy cannot promise a precise wait - it says "wait a while"
Verify a level (EMAIL first, then PHONE)
open /verify (AuthGuard) or the shell's Verify link
Dev senders log the code to the backend console ([DEV SMTP]/[DEV SMS]);
smtp-pulse / Twilio deliver for real once .env credentials are set.
addLevel(level) ' optimistic - no GET /me to re-read claims
generic "invalid or expired" copy - stay on the code phase
conflict (no code is sent, no throttle consumed)
addLevel(level) ' the server says the claim exists
info notice "already verified" - never an error banner
too many requests (cooldown OR daily cap)
rate-limit copy, no auto-retry (resend = manual request again)
SMART_ID is never offered - the backend rejects it with 400 (stub in v1).
Level state is SESSION-LOCAL: after a reload the page shows both buttons
again (no GET /me in v1 - reported gap); the first request re-discovers a
verified level via the 409 above and re-hides the panel.
Contact change: email -> SMS proof to the current phone (cross-channel)
backend sends the OTP to the CURRENT PHONE (SMS), NOT to the new
email - stealing the mailbox alone cannot change the contact.
202 Accepted (empty - the backend never echoes the destination)
"we sent an SMS code to the phone number on your account"
Copy names the CHANNEL only: without GET /me there is no masked
"+372..." to truthfully show (md examples were aspirational - gap).
success - shows the NEW email (known locally)
request 400 "same as current" -> "the new one must be different" copy;
duplicate target 409 -> backend message inline; wrong/expired/no-pending
code on confirm -> generic copy. Sessions are NOT revoked by a contact
change (only a password reset revokes refresh tokens).
Contact change: phone -> email proof to the current address (cross-channel)
backend sends the OTP to the CURRENT EMAIL - losing the SIM alone
"we sent an email code to the email address on your account"
M3 as-built: AuthStore.levels() is an optimistic mirror (confirm success or
request-409 adds the level; login/logout/cleared session resets it). The
account page never shows a server-truthful "current email/phone" before a
change - candidate backend follow-up: GET /me (04-CONTEXT decision 3).
